mapper.sql: CASE WHEN u.phonenumber IS NULL OR TRIM(u.phonenumber) = '' THEN NULL WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(u.phonenumber) >= 7 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(u.phonenumber, 3), '****', RIGHT(u.phonenumber, 4)) ELSE '***' END
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET nick_name = #{nickName}, update_by = 'app-user-center', update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = '0'
UPDATE sys_user SET avatar = #{avatar}, update_by = 'app-user-center', update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = '0'
UPDATE sys_user SET phonenumber = #{phone}, update_by = 'app-user-center', update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_phone_change_log (user_id, old_phone_mask, new_phone_mask, result, client_ip, device_id, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{oldPhoneMask}, #{newPhoneMask}, #{result}, #{clientIp}, #{deviceId}, 'app-user-center', NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT rna.id AS application_id, rna.user_id, rna.real_name_mask, rna.id_number_mask, rna.material_ref, rna.status, rna.reject_reason, rna.create_time AS submitted_at, rna.audited_at AS reviewed_at FROM user_real_name_auth rna WHERE rna.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY rna.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT rna.status FROM user_real_name_auth rna WHERE rna.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY rna.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_real_name_auth (user_id, real_name_mask, id_number_mask, material_ref, status, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{realNameMask}, #{idNumberMask}, #{materialRef}, #{status}, 'app-user-center', NOW())
mapper.sql: n.id AS message_id, n.type, n.title, n.body AS content, n.business_type, COALESCE(n.business_id, n.biz_ref) AS business_id, (r.read_at IS NOT NULL) AS is_read, r.read_at, n.create_time AS created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_notification_receiver r JOIN user_notification n ON n.id = r.notification_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.notification_id = #{messageId} AND r.deleted_flag = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_notification_receiver r WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted_flag = 0 AND r.read_at IS NULL

SELECT n.type AS type, COUNT(*) AS total FROM user_notification_receiver r JOIN user_notification n ON n.id = r.notification_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted_flag = 0 AND r.read_at IS NULL GROUP BY n.type
SELECT id, user_id, channel, type, enabled FROM user_notification_preference WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY channel, type
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_notification_preference (user_id, channel, type, enabled, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{channel}, #{type}, #{enabled}, 'app-user-center', NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled = VALUES(enabled), update_by = 'app-user-center', update_time = NOW()

INSERT INTO user_feedback (user_id, category, content, attachment_ref, status, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{category}, #{content}, #{attachmentRef}, #{status}, 'app-user-center', NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT f.id AS feedback_id, f.category, f.content, f.status, f.reply, f.attachment_ref, f.create_time AS submitted_at, f.handled_at FROM user_feedback f WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.id = #{feedbackId} LIMIT 1
